summary: Jackson explicitly calls Gaza a genocide, names Netanyahu a war criminal to be prosecuted, and has vowed never to vote for U.S. taxpayer-funded military aid to Israel. At a September 2026 town hall he refused to support additional bombs or aid; at the October 2026 debate he opposed giving Israel a 'blank check.' He sidestepped the issue at his July 2026 nomination speech and, after backlash, apologized for remarks about Jewish Maine residents while maintaining the genocide framing.
